title: Raising the Cost of Malicious AI-Powered Image Editing (PhotoGuard)
authors: Hadi Salman, Alaa Khaddaj, Guillaume Leclerc, Andrew Ilyas, Aleksander Madry
abstract: Proposes encoder-attack (pushing latent representation to target) and diffusion-attack (differentiating through denoiser ODE) to disrupt Stable Diffusion inpainting and img2img.
key_insights: Proposes encoder-attack (pushing latent representation to target) and diffusion-attack (differentiating through denoiser ODE) to disrupt Stable Diffusion inpainting and img2img.
persoshield_relevance: Direct mathematical basis for Layer C; establishes that latent space disruptions break open diffusion models, but suffer from limited transferability to closed MLLMs.

title: Adversarial Example Does Good: Preventing Painting Imitation from Diffusion Models (AdvDM / Mist)
authors: Chumeng Liang, Xiaoyu Wu, Yang Hua, Jiyan He, Zihui Xue, Tao Song, Shuang Liang, Haibing Guan
abstract: Combines textural loss on VAE latent space with semantic loss on intermediate diffusion denoiser features to prevent AI art imitation.
key_insights: Combines textural loss on VAE latent space with semantic loss on intermediate diffusion denoiser features to prevent AI art imitation.
persoshield_relevance: Provides the multi-objective loss formulation combining perceptual fidelity with latent disruption.

title: Toward Effective Protection Against Diffusion-Based Mimicry through Score Distillation
authors: Haotian Xue, Chumeng Liang, Xiaoyu Wu, Yongxin Chen
abstract: Demonstrates that the image encoder is the most vulnerable module in generative diffusion pipelines; uses Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) to reduce crafting memory by 75%.
key_insights: Demonstrates that the image encoder is the most vulnerable module in generative diffusion pipelines; uses Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) to reduce crafting memory by 75%.
persoshield_relevance: Validates targeting vision encoders rather than unrolling memory-intensive diffusion ODE timesteps.

title: Pixel is a Barrier: Diffusion Models Are More Adversarially Robust Than We Think
authors: Haotian Xue, Yongxin Chen
abstract: Proves that pixel-space diffusion models naturally filter out latent-space perturbations; latent attacks on VAEs completely fail against pixel-space or non-LDM generative models.
key_insights: Proves that pixel-space diffusion models naturally filter out latent-space perturbations; latent attacks on VAEs completely fail against pixel-space or non-LDM generative models.
persoshield_relevance: Explains why legacy PersoShield V2 (VAE perturbations) failed against Gemini 2.5 Flash, directly necessitating the v3 Multi-Tier architecture.

title: EditShield: Protecting Unauthorized Image Editing by Instruction-Guided Diffusion Models
authors: Yingqian Chen, Chaowei Xiao, et al.
abstract: Optimizes cross-attention and latent-shifting perturbations with Expectation Over Transformations (EOT) specifically targeting instruction-guided editors like InstructPix2Pix.
key_insights: Optimizes cross-attention and latent-shifting perturbations with Expectation Over Transformations (EOT) specifically targeting instruction-guided editors like InstructPix2Pix.
persoshield_relevance: Direct defense against instruction-driven text prompts ('put a hat', 'make clown').

title: DiffusionGuard: A Robust Defense Against Malicious Diffusion-Based Image Editing
authors: Junyoung Choi, et al.
abstract: Identifies that early diffusion timesteps govern coarse layout while late timesteps govern fine details; crafts perturbations targeting early-timestep inversion trajectories.
key_insights: Identifies that early diffusion timesteps govern coarse layout while late timesteps govern fine details; crafts perturbations targeting early-timestep inversion trajectories.
persoshield_relevance: Prevents selective inpainting and bounding-box edits.

title: AdvPaint: Protecting Images from Inpainting Manipulation via Adversarial Attention Disruption
authors: Zhengyuan Zhao, et al.
abstract: Disrupts spatial cross-attention maps within inpainting models, forcing the generator to fill masked regions with discordant artifacts.
key_insights: Disrupts spatial cross-attention maps within inpainting models, forcing the generator to fill masked regions with discordant artifacts.
persoshield_relevance: Technical defense against AI clothing removal and body modification inpainting.

title: MetaCloak: Practical Adversarial Perturbation Against Image-to-Image Personalization
authors: Yixin Liu, Chenrui Tao, et al.
abstract: Formulates adversarial protection as a meta-learning bilevel optimization problem; achieves robust transfer across multiple model architectures under JPEG compression.
key_insights: Formulates adversarial protection as a meta-learning bilevel optimization problem; achieves robust transfer across multiple model architectures under JPEG compression.
persoshield_relevance: EOT transformation schedule and JPEG-survival optimization principles.

title: Anti-DreamBooth: Protecting Users from Personalized Text-to-Image Synthesis
authors: Thanh Van Le, Hao Phung, Quan Nguyen, Thuan Hoang Nguyen, Tran Khanh, Anh Tran
abstract: Introduces Adversarial Soft-Prompt Learning (ASPL) to prevent fine-tuning of diffusion models on personal facial images.
key_insights: Introduces Adversarial Soft-Prompt Learning (ASPL) to prevent fine-tuning of diffusion models on personal facial images.
persoshield_relevance: Protects against personal LoRA training and customized portrait generation.

title: Edit Away and My Face Will Not Stay: Personal Biometric Defense against Malicious Generative Editing (FaceLock)
authors: Hao Wang, Jiazhen Zhang, Songhe Bai, Mengnan Zhao, Yong Liu, Mengmeng Tu
abstract: Establishes that output identity preservation is the true vulnerability metric; formulates an adversarial objective that guarantees that if an editor alters the image, the biometric facial identity completely uncouples.
key_insights: Establishes that output identity preservation is the true vulnerability metric; formulates an adversarial objective that guarantees that if an editor alters the image, the biometric facial identity completely uncouples.
persoshield_relevance: Theoretical inspiration for PersoShield Arm V2: decoupling facial embeddings rather than merely trying to cause a pipeline crash.

title: Fawkes: Protecting Personal Privacy against Unauthorized Deep Learning Models
authors: Shawn Shan, Emily Wenger, Jiayun Zhang, Huiying Li, Haitao Zheng, Ben Y. Zhao
abstract: Pioneers feature-space image cloaking; computes minimal pixel perturbations that shift facial representations in deep feature space toward an attractor centroid.
key_insights: Pioneers feature-space image cloaking; computes minimal pixel perturbations that shift facial representations in deep feature space toward an attractor centroid.
persoshield_relevance: Foundational work on user-side biometric cloaking.

title: LowKey: Leveraging Heterogeneous Models to Attack Unknown Neural Networks
authors: Valeriia Cherepanova, Micah Goldblum, Harrison Foley, Shrunal Nirmal, John P. Dickerson, Tom Goldstein
abstract: Attacks an ensemble of heterogeneous face recognition models (ArcFace, CosFace, MobileFace) to achieve black-box cross-architecture transferability.
key_insights: Attacks an ensemble of heterogeneous face recognition models (ArcFace, CosFace, MobileFace) to achieve black-box cross-architecture transferability.
persoshield_relevance: Guides multi-encoder surrogate design in PersoShield Layer A.

title: Adversarial Perturbations Cannot Reliably Protect Artists From Generative AI
authors: Robert Hoenig, Javier Rando, Nicholas Carlini, Florian Tramer
abstract: Exhaustively demonstrates that existing adversarial protections (Glaze, Mist, Anti-DreamBooth) can be bypassed by simple purification: noisy upscaling, Gaussian blur, DiffPure, and modern robust encoders.
key_insights: Exhaustively demonstrates that existing adversarial protections (Glaze, Mist, Anti-DreamBooth) can be bypassed by simple purification: noisy upscaling, Gaussian blur, DiffPure, and modern robust encoders.
persoshield_relevance: The core motivation for PersoShield's multi-tier hybrid approach: adversarial pixel noise alone is vulnerable to purification, so it must be paired with typographic consent injection and C2PA provenance.

title: IMPRESS: Evaluating the Resilience of Imperceptible Perturbations Against Diffusion Purification
authors: Bochuan Cao, et al.
abstract: Evaluates adversarial perturbation survivability under consistency-based diffusion purification; shows that standard high-frequency perturbations are erased in 3-5 reverse diffusion steps.
key_insights: Evaluates adversarial perturbation survivability under consistency-based diffusion purification; shows that standard high-frequency perturbations are erased in 3-5 reverse diffusion steps.
persoshield_relevance: Defines our adaptive adversary test suite in benchmarks/run_adversarial_suite.py.

title: Can Protective Perturbation Safeguard Personal Data from Being Exploited by Stable Diffusion? (GrIDPure)
authors: Zhengyu Zhao, et al.
abstract: Demonstrates grid-based perceptual purification algorithms capable of neutralising anti-customization protections without significant loss of visual resolution.
key_insights: Demonstrates grid-based perceptual purification algorithms capable of neutralising anti-customization protections without significant loss of visual resolution.
persoshield_relevance: Used to evaluate the robustness of PersoShield Layer B DCT watermarking against grid downsampling.

title: How Robust is Google's Bard to Adversarial Image Attacks?
authors: Yinpeng Dong, Huanran Chen, Jiantao Qiu, Jiayu Liu, Bochen Wang, Zhaoxi Chen, Yang Hao, Hanqing Zhao, Yibo Miao, Xiao Yang, Hang Su, Jun Zhu
abstract: First empirical study of black-box transfer attacks against Google's commercial vision-language models; achieved 22% transfer rate to Bard and evaded toxicity safety filters.
key_insights: First empirical study of black-box transfer attacks against Google's commercial vision-language models; achieved 22% transfer rate to Bard and evaded toxicity safety filters.
persoshield_relevance: Establishes baseline empirical expectations for zero-query transferability to Gemini 2.5.

title: On Evaluating Adversarial Robustness of Large Vision-Language Models (AttackVLM)
authors: Yunqing Zhao, et al.
abstract: Demonstrates that multimodal LLMs are susceptible to cross-modal perceptual hijacking by aligning image embeddings with disruptive text tokens.
key_insights: Demonstrates that multimodal LLMs are susceptible to cross-modal perceptual hijacking by aligning image embeddings with disruptive text tokens.
persoshield_relevance: Framework for perception hijacking across open and closed MLLMs.

title: A Frustratingly Simple Yet Highly Effective Attack Baseline: Over 90% Success Rate Against the Strong Black-box Models of GPT-4.5/4o/o1 (M-Attack & M-Attack-v2)
authors: Zhengyuan Li, et al.
abstract: Discovers that commercial MLLMs process images through multi-crop vision transformers; optimizing perturbations across multi-scale random crops achieves >90% black-box transfer to GPT-4.5/4o and Gemini 2.5.
key_insights: Discovers that commercial MLLMs process images through multi-crop vision transformers; optimizing perturbations across multi-scale random crops achieves >90% black-box transfer to GPT-4.5/4o and Gemini 2.5.
persoshield_relevance: The direct mathematical foundation for PersoShield Arm V2 (core/v3/m_attack.py), enabling 50% biometric decoupling on Gemini 2.5 Flash.

title: Leave My Images Alone: Preventing Multi-Modal Large Language Models from Analyzing Images via Visual Prompt Injection (ImageProtector)
authors: Yuanhao Shao, et al.
abstract: Optimizes visual perturbations that trick MLLM safety classifiers into categorizing benign personal photos as severe policy violations, inducing automatic refusal.
key_insights: Optimizes visual perturbations that trick MLLM safety classifiers into categorizing benign personal photos as severe policy violations, inducing automatic refusal.
persoshield_relevance: Demonstrates refusal induction as a viable defensive mechanism against AI analysis.

title: Image Hijacks: Adversarial Images can Control Generative Models at Runtime
authors: Luke Bailey, Euan Ong, Stuart Russell, David Krueger
abstract: Proves that visually imperceptible image perturbations can force generative vision-language models to execute embedded instructions (e.g. refuse, output specific text, leak keys).
key_insights: Proves that visually imperceptible image perturbations can force generative vision-language models to execute embedded instructions (e.g. refuse, output specific text, leak keys).
persoshield_relevance: Theoretical foundation for visual instruction injection into closed generative pipelines.

title: DoPE: Decoy Oriented Perturbation Encapsulation: Human-Readable, AI-Hostile Documents for Academic and Content Integrity
authors: R. Shekhar, et al.
abstract: Exploits human-vs-machine rendering discrepancies and typographic prompt injection to embed overt legal constraints that force MLLM vision streams to trigger content safety refusals.
key_insights: Exploits human-vs-machine rendering discrepancies and typographic prompt injection to embed overt legal constraints that force MLLM vision streams to trigger content safety refusals.
persoshield_relevance: Direct mathematical and operational basis for PersoShield Arm V1 (Typographic Consent Stamp: 'PERSONALSHIELD PROTECTED: NO CONSENT FOR AI EDITING').

title: Glaze: Protecting Artists from Style Mimicry by Text-to-Image Models
authors: Shawn Shan, Jenna Cryan, Emily Wenger, Haitao Zheng, Rana Hanocka, Ben Y. Zhao
abstract: Pioneers style cloaking by perturbing images in feature space to mimic a distant artistic style, preventing style mimicry fine-tuning.
key_insights: Pioneers style cloaking by perturbing images in feature space to mimic a distant artistic style, preventing style mimicry fine-tuning.
persoshield_relevance: Foundational style-protection prior; inspired PersoShield's multi-encoder feature extraction.

title: Nightshade: Prompt-Specific Poisoning Attacks on Text-to-Image Generative Models
authors: Shawn Shan, Wenxin Ding, Joey Bost, Haitao Zheng, Ben Y. Zhao
abstract: Computes prompt-specific poison perturbations that corrupt text-to-image concept bindings in generative foundation models.
key_insights: Computes prompt-specific poison perturbations that corrupt text-to-image concept bindings in generative foundation models.
persoshield_relevance: Active defense paradigm showing how data owners can disrupt unauthorized model training.

title: Diffusion-Based Adversarial Purification (DiffPure)
authors: Weili Nie, Brandon Guo, Yujia Huang, Chaowei Xiao, Arash Vahdat, Anima Anandkumar
abstract: Applies forward diffusion noise followed by reverse generative denoising to purify adversarial perturbations from images.
key_insights: Applies forward diffusion noise followed by reverse generative denoising to purify adversarial perturbations from images.
persoshield_relevance: Gold standard adaptive adversary purification baseline that any modern defense must withstand.

title: WAVES: Benchmarking the Robustness of Image Watermarking Against Generative and Adversarial Attacks
authors: Pierre Fernandez, et al.
abstract: Comprehensive evaluation of digital watermarks (DCT, DWT, Tree-Ring, StegaStamp) against generative AI editing; highlights vulnerability of metadata without dual-domain redundancy.
key_insights: Comprehensive evaluation of digital watermarks (DCT, DWT, Tree-Ring, StegaStamp) against generative AI editing; highlights vulnerability of metadata without dual-domain redundancy.
persoshield_relevance: Direct benchmark criteria for PersoShield Layer B (DiffJPEG DCT spread-spectrum) and Layer D (C2PA v2.1).
